mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_member ( member_id, site_id, site_code, login_id, password, password_changed_at, role_ids, member_name, nickname, email, email_hash, email_verified_yn, phone, phone_hash, birth_date, birth_year, gender, di, di_hash, parent_name, parent_di, parent_di_hash, address_zipcode, address, address_detail, join_type, status, privacy_agree_yn, terms_agree_yn, marketing_agree_yn, sms_agree_yn, email_agree_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{siteId}, #{siteCode}, #{loginId}, #{password}, #{passwordChangedAt}, #{roleIds}, #{memberName, typeHandler=com.gonet.common.crypto.PiiTypeHandler}, #{nickname}, #{email, typeHandler=com.gonet.common.crypto.PiiTypeHandler}, #{emailHash}, #{emailVerifiedYn}, #{phone, typeHandler=com.gonet.common.crypto.PiiTypeHandler}, #{phoneHash}, #{birthDate, typeHandler=com.gonet.common.crypto.PiiTypeHandler}, #{birthYear}, #{gender}, #{di, typeHandler=com.gonet.common.crypto.PiiTypeHandler}, #{diHash}, #{parentName, typeHandler=com.gonet.common.crypto.PiiTypeHandler}, #{parentDi, typeHandler=com.gonet.common.crypto.PiiTypeHandler}, #{parentDiHash}, #{addressZipcode}, #{address, typeHandler=com.gonet.common.crypto.PiiTypeHandler}, #{addressDetail, typeHandler=com.gonet.common.crypto.PiiTypeHandler}, #{joinType}, #{status}, #{privacyAgreeYn}, #{termsAgreeYn}, #{marketingAgreeYn}, #{smsAgreeYn}, #{emailAgreeYn}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_member WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_member WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND login_id = #{loginId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_member WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND email_hash = #{emailHash} AND delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT * FROM tb_member WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND email_hash = #{emailHash} AND delete_yn = 'N' AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_member WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND di_hash = #{diHash} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_member SET password = #{password}, password_changed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, password_expire_at = #{passwordExpireAt}, login_fail_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_member_consent (member_consent_id, member_id, consent_type, consent_version, agree_yn, agreed_at, client_ip, user_agent, created_by, created_ip, created_at) VALUES (#{memberConsentId}, #{memberId}, #{consentType}, #{consentVersion}, #{agreeYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
